item.title: Labour council's Christmas Parade is this Sunday: what you need to know
item.description:
Swansea's Labour council starts the festive season this Sunday with the Christmas Parade. Santa leaves the Guildhall at 5pm, buses are free and there are quiet viewing areas.
#Castle #Christmas #Swansea #SwanseaLabour

item.title: Labour council asks residents for their views, with £50 vouchers to be won
item.description:
Swansea's Labour council wants to hear from residents in its survey, Let's Talk: Living in Swansea. It closes on 6 December and there are £50 shopping vouchers to be won.
#HaveYourSay #Swansea #SwanseaLabour

item.title: Labour welcomes new Men's Shed at Dyfatty Junction community hub
item.description:
A new Men's Shed has launched at Dyfatty Junction, offering free weekly drop-in sessions. Swansea's Labour council is working with the project.
#Castle #CommunitySupport #Swansea #SwanseaLabour

item.title: Labour council buys former TSB building for new young people's hub on The Kingsway
item.description:
Swansea's Labour council has bought the former TSB building on The Kingsway. It plans a major new city centre hub where young people and families can get support in one place.
#Castle #CommunitySupport #Swansea #SwanseaLabour

item.title: Labour sets out 10-year vision for greener, safer parks across Swansea
item.description:
Swansea's Labour council has approved a 10-year vision for its 149 parks, building on more than £11m already invested in play areas and skate and wheeled sports facilities.
#Parks #Swansea #SwanseaLabour

item.title: Labour's free buses are back this weekend: parade road closures to know
item.description:
Labour's free buses return on 21 and 22 November for Swansea's Christmas Parade weekend. Here are the free bus dates and Sunday's road closures and parking restrictions.
#Castle #Buses #Swansea #SwanseaLabour

item.title: Hannah Laing to play Singleton Park as Labour's Swansea lines up summer 2027
item.description:
Scottish DJ Hannah Laing will play Singleton Park on Saturday 21 August 2027. Swansea's Labour-run council shared the news, with presale tickets opening on 25 November.
#Sketty #WhatsOn #Swansea #SwanseaLabour

item.title: Labour backs 30 affordable homes at Swansea's historic Castle Cinema
item.description:
Swansea's Labour council is helping to fund the restoration of the historic Castle Cinema building, which is being turned into 30 affordable homes, offices and a café or restaurant.
#Castle #Housing #Swansea #SwanseaLabour

item.title: Labour's Castle Square Gardens on course to open next summer
item.description:
Swansea's new-look Castle Square Gardens is on target to open next summer. Labour council leader Cllr Rob Stewart visited the site this week to see the progress.
#Castle #CityCentre #Swansea #SwanseaLabour

item.title: Labour welcomes first gondola tower for Swansea's Kilvey Hill cable car
item.description:
The first gondola tower for Swansea's new cable car is standing at the base of Kilvey Hill. Labour council leader Cllr Rob Stewart has welcomed the progress.
#Landore #StThomas #Regeneration #Swansea #SwanseaLabour

item.title: Labour council confirms free Wales Airshow returns on 24 and 25 July 2027
item.description:
Wales' largest free event is coming back. Swansea's Labour council has confirmed the Wales Airshow will return on 24 and 25 July 2027, with an invite going to the Red Arrows.
#WhatsOn #Swansea #SwanseaLabour

item.title: Labour council lines up weeks of festive family fun for Swansea city centre
item.description:
Swansea's Labour council is bringing weeks of Christmas events to the city centre, from Winter Wonderland on 19 November to the Fire & Ice Festival on 5 December, with free festive buses too.
#Christmas #Swansea #SwanseaLabour

item.title: St Helen's hosts first international since Labour council-backed redevelopment
item.description:
International rugby has been played at St Helen's for the first time since the redevelopment supported by Swansea's Labour council, with Wales U19s beating France U19s 34 - 31.
#Sport #Swansea #SwanseaLabour

Swansea's Labour council is moving ahead with its major scheme to protect Killay from flooding. Traffic around Killay Square changes from Monday 16 November.
